normalized.result:
This looks good — it covers what I care about: saving links, tagging them, searching and filtering, sorting, marking favorites, archiving, editing, deleting with a confirmation step, catching duplicate links, and keeping everything saved between sessions. That's the heart of what I want.

One thing I'll flag, though it's not a dealbreaker: I'd assumed that when I paste in a link, the app would fill in the title for me so I don't have to type one every time. Your spec has me entering the title myself and requires it. I can live with that for a first version, so no need to change it — I just want to be honest that quicker saving was in the back of my mind for later.

Approved — please go ahead and create the implementation plan.
